title: Pocketwire Rewards Giving Recognition Terms: The Charity Giving Lift
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members who donated to partner charities over the last twelve months receive a giving lift on the rate at which their points are valued for a charity donation.

## Terms

The charity giving lift is 0.20 US cents per point when the ledger carries at least 2 charity redemptions dated within the last twelve months and the membership has completed at least 3 whole years; it is 0.10 cents per point when the member does not meet that first condition but the ledger carries at least 1 charity redemption dated within the last twelve months and the membership has completed at least 1 whole year; and it is nothing otherwise.

The lift is added to the charity rate per point before the rate is applied to the points donated.

A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date. The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down.

## Lift by giving and years

| Charity redemptions within the last twelve months | Whole years of membership | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 or more | 0.20 |
| 2 or more | 1 or 2 | 0.10 |
| 1 | 1 or more | 0.10 |
| 1 or more | 0 | nothing |
| none | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Three charity donations in the window and 4 whole years: 0.20 cents per point.
- One charity donation and two gift card redemptions in the window, 5 whole years: only the charity donation counts; 0.10 cents per point.
